name: Hover Card
description: A rich preview surface revealed on hover or focus, for context without navigation.

anatomy.description: The inline element, often a Link or handle, that opens the card on hover or keyboard focus.
The rich preview surface with identity or summary content; read-only by convention.

dos: Use for entity previews, like a person or project summary, that help before navigating.
Tune openDelay and closeDelay when cards sit in dense lists so they don't flicker.
Keep the content a short read-only summary.
donts: Don't put required actions inside; touch users can't hover, so offer another path.
Don't use it for a one-line hint; use Tooltip.
Don't rely on a hover card for information that only exists there.

examples.title: Preview on hover
examples.description: Delays are tunable; keyboard focus opens the card too.

examples.title: Tuned delays and placement
examples.description: openDelay, closeDelay, side, and align adapt the card to dense layouts like member lists.

examples.title: Identity preview
examples.description: Show a person or project summary without leaving the list.

guidance.useWhen: Rich preview context helps before committing to navigation.
guidance.avoidWhen: The content is a short hint; use Tooltip, or must be interacted with on touch; use Popover.
guidance.behavior: Hover and keyboard focus open the card after a tunable delay.
guidance.responsive: Provide the same content through another path on touch layouts.

keyboard.action: Opens the card when the trigger receives keyboard focus.

notes: Keyboard focus opens the card on the same content as hover, so the preview is not pointer-only.
Keep card content read-only; interactive content belongs in a Popover.
Touch users cannot hover, so anything important in the card needs another visible path.
